name: justai
description: Marketer-facing plugin for planning, building, validating, reviewing, and understanding journeys through the JustAI Platform.

interface.shortDescription: Campaign planning and editable journey workflows.
interface.longDescription: Helps marketers research audiences, design campaign sequences, build and validate editable journeys, review content quality, and prepare lifecycle changes on the JustAI Platform.
defaultPrompt: Create a win-back journey for dormant silver users, validate it, and show me its diagram.
Update my onboarding journey, keep unrelated steps unchanged, and re-check readiness.
Design a multi-touch onboarding sequence with email and push for new signups, then show which steps fit the current runtime.
Analyze my silver-tier audience and recommend the best campaign approach.
Review the copy quality of my active journeys before I make a lifecycle change.
Summarize the configuration, readiness, and risks of my upsell journey.
Build a competitive brief against [competitor] to inform our next campaign messaging.
